details.invariant: Valid Semantic DSL parse/format/parse is deterministic and identity-stable; bounded arbitrary UTF-8 never panics.
Legacy regex import remains deterministic, bounded, provenance-preserving, and normalizes only after successful parse.
Normalization is deterministic, idempotent, input-immutable, canonical, and rejects malformed candidates before transformation.
Semantic analysis is deterministic and panic-free for bounded valid and malformed candidates and preserves complete fact identity.
Structural analysis produces reproducible length, progress, leading-consumption, and overlap facts and rejects mismatched evidence.
UTF-8 half-open source spans, origins, related evidence, and generated diagnostics remain valid, exact, deterministic, and bounded.
Canonical compile requests are immutable, byte-deterministic, resource-bounded, profile-sensitive, and reject malformed serialized mutations without panic.
PCRE2 lowering and serialization remain byte-deterministic, UTF-8 safe, profile-exact, and input-immutable across generated programs.
ECMAScript lowering and serialization remain byte-deterministic, UTF-8 safe, profile-exact, and input-immutable across generated programs.
Python re text and bytes lowering and serialization remain deterministic, profile-exact, input-immutable, and fail closed on kind mutations.
Every extracted semantic requirement receives one reproducible native, equivalent, unsupported, or unresolved disposition without false promotion.
Explanation and migration output is byte-deterministic, source-conservative, correspondence-bound, and never promotes unknown or lossy evidence.
Bounded Simply graphs, cloned handles, imported sources, malformed host inputs, and serialized requests remain deterministic and immutable.
Arbitrary bytes, structured protocol mutations, ownership cycles, and serialized canonical requests remain deterministic across the native interop boundary.
